transcript: hey wicked fans i have a really strange request so back in december of 2010 the national tour of wicked was in chicago and at that time i reviewed theater uh pretty frequently and the press person representing wicked contacted me Out of the blue and said hey bob do you wanna show up for an event tonight and i was like what is it and she's like just show up it'll be fun so i show up at this place called the kenmore studios and i'm paired up with Chandra Lee Schwartz who was playing Glinda at the time and we're told that we're competing in a cooking contest against Elphaba who was played by carla stickler she was the stand by and if you know carla stickler - 0micr0n Elphaba she's legend they was truly wild and the segment was on youtube for many years but it's been since long gone i can't find it anywhere all that exists is this promo clip yeah just join me Chandra lee Schwartz and carla stickler live december nineteenth at the kenmore live studios for the cooking combat wicked style where i will royally kick Elphaba’s green butt - you have to be that way? yes. See? Misunderstood. so if some wicked fan has this saved on their hard drive perhaps i would love to see it it was just a wild memory
